```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
library(data.table)

```

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}

data <- read_csv("SP_data_alt.csv", locale = locale(encoding = "ISO-8859-1"))

data <- data|>
  mutate(dow = str_extract(`Incident Date - Day Name`, "(?<=- )\\w+$"))


data|>
  summarize(across(1:30, ~ sum(is.na(.x))))|>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = 1:30,
    names_to = "feature",
    values_to = "NA's"
  )|>
  view()


dates <- data |>
  mutate(
    date = mdy_hms(`Incident Date Time`),
    `mm/yyyy` = format(date, "%m/%Y"),
    month = my(`mm/yyyy`),
    season = case_when(
      month(date) %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ (year(date) - 2021) * 4 + 1,
      month(date) %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ (year(date) - 2021) * 4 + 2,
      month(date) %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ (year(date) - 2021) * 4 + 3,
      month(date) %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ (year(date) - 2021) * 4 + 4
    ),
    season_label = case_when(
      month(date) %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ paste("Winter", year(date)),
      month(date) %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ paste("Spring", year(date)),
      month(date) %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ paste("Summer", year(date)),
      month(date) %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ paste("Fall", year(date))
    )
  )|>
    arrange(date)

NAs <- dates|>
  mutate(across((1:30)[-17], ~ as.integer(!is.na(.x))))|>
  view()

NAplot <- function(x){
  p <- NAs |>
    ggplot(aes(
      x = `date`,
      y = .data[[names(NAs)[x]]],
      color = factor(.data[[names(NAs)[x]]])
    )) +
    geom_point()+
    theme(
  legend.position = "none")

  print(p)
  
}
NAplot(1)
NAplot(2)
NAplot(3)
```
